text: Prices are public and the same for every market. One file: 29 USD one-time. Single dataset: 99 USD per month or 990 USD per year. All datasets: 299 USD per month or 2,990 USD per year. Academic use: 79 USD one-time for one dataset. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time; annual licences do not renew automatically. Free samples, data dictionaries and coverage tables are available before purchase.
